svg.title: Ring all-reduce on a 4x4x4 torus
svg.text: Ring all-reduce on a 4x4x4 torus (64 chips)
reduce-scatter, phase 1 of 3: shard A on X, B on Y, C on Z
reduce-scatter, phase 2 of 3: shard C on X, A on Y, B on Z
reduce-scatter, phase 3 of 3: shard B on X, C on Y, A on Z
all-gather, phase 3 of 3: shard B on X, C on Y, A on Z
all-gather, phase 2 of 3: shard C on X, A on Y, B on Z
all-gather, phase 1 of 3: shard A on X, B on Y, C on Z
Every link busy in both directions; 18 neighbour steps; dots shrink as each shard is reduced. Not to scale.
